Inverse Design of Tunable Infrared Metasurface Absorbers via a Conditional Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network
arXiv preprint (physics.optics)　·　2026-02-02　·　原文链接
论文解决的问题
窄带完美吸收器的设计依赖直觉迭代，缺乏灵活性和多目标优化能力。
核心方法与结构
提出条件WGAN逆向设计框架，采用双通道图像编码同时表示Si3N4超表面的几何与厚度，生成满足目标光谱的多种结构。
关键结果
共振峰误差小于5 nm，MSE约10^-3，每个目标可生成超过10种不同高性能设计，并在10°-40°斜入射下通过迁移学习保持精度。
与我们项目的关联
仿真方法/结构设计环节：逆向设计框架可直接用于我们的超表面结构优化，尤其是有限周期相位补偿。
可借鉴的点
  • 双通道图像编码同时表示几何与厚度，可迁移到我们的TiO2纳米柱参数化
  • 条件WGAN生成多种候选设计，可解决“一对多”问题，用于探索鲁棒结构
需要注意 / 待验证
训练数据需大量RCWA/FDTD仿真，且需验证在可见光波段的泛化能力。
建议下一步
用我们已有的LC500/LC1000参数扫描数据训练一个类似的WGAN，生成对周期不敏感的结构。
逆向设计WGAN超表面吸收器深度学习
查看英文摘要原文

Narrowband perfect absorbers are interesting for spectrum sensing, molecular detection, and infrared imaging. However, their design remains constrained by intuitive, iterative methods that lack flexibility, while also facing challenges in multi-objective optimization. Here, we introduce a deep learning-enabled inverse-design framework that overcomes these limitations through a conditional Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (WGAN). The main contribution of this work is a dual-channel image encoding scheme that jointly represents the geometry and thickness of a Si$_3$N$_4$ meta-layer, facilitating the network to learn the distribution of viable structures for a target optical response. This approach naturally solves the inherent ``one-to-many'' design issue, giving a diverse portfolio of functional candidates from a single input spectrum. The designed absorbers achieve exceptional spectral fidelity, with resonance peak errors below 5 nm, a mean squared error (MSE) on the order of $10^{-3}$, and the capacity to produce over 10 distinct, high-performance designs per target. 用于宽角三维波束扫描与目标跟踪的主动半球形超表面透射阵天线

论文解决的问题

核心方法与结构
在250 GHz下设计堆叠多层半球形石墨烯透射阵，包含121个独立可调的石墨烯扇形单元，通过栅压调节石墨烯化学势实现动态调控，并用CST宏自动化建模。

与我们项目的关联
电极与寻址环节：其独立寻址方案可借鉴到我们的像素化ITO电极设计，但频段与材料差异大。
可借鉴的点
  • 多层堆叠与独立栅压寻址的阵列架构，可启发高密度像素电极的布线策略
  • 半球形几何的自动化建模宏，可用于快速生成复杂曲面阵列
需要注意 / 待验证
石墨烯在可见光的调控能力弱，且121单元寻址的串扰与功耗需评估。
建议下一步
调研石墨烯在可见光波段的复折射率调制范围，判断是否可用于辅助相位调控。

圆双折射等离激元结构中基于基无关的几何相位调制

Basis‐Independent Geometric Phase Modulation in Circularly Birefringent Plasmonic Structures
Advanced Optical Materials (Online First)　·　2026-10-24　·　原文链接　·　DOI: 10.1002/adom.71959
论文解决的问题
传统几何相位依赖线双折射超原子在圆偏振下工作，缺乏基无关的相位调制。
核心方法与结构
设计空间旋转的手性螺旋等离激元超表面，产生空间变化的圆延迟，在线偏振下观察几何相位光栅。
关键结果
实现了等效闪耀光栅的衍射 orders，并验证了相位几何起源。

可借鉴的点
  • 圆双折射产生几何相位的机制，可探索用于液晶超表面的偏振无关相位
  • 空间旋转手性结构的设计方法
需要注意 / 待验证

建议下一步

查看英文摘要原文

ABSTRACT Geometric phase in metasurfaces is conventionally realized using spatially rotated linearly birefringent meta–atoms under circularly polarized illumination. Here we demonstrate that a geometric phase modulation can be achieved through circular birefringence and observed under linear polarization excitation. We introduce a plasmonic metasurface composed of spatially rotated chiral spiral unit cells designed to produce space‐variant circular retardance. This generates a geometric phase ramp equivalent to a blazed grating, leading to diffraction orders in momentum space. Using leakage radiation microscopy, we directly resolve these orders and show how their intensities depend upon the input linear polarization confirming the geometric origin of the phase. We theoretically analyze the phenomenon using a rotated Poincaré space and confirm our results by direct Stokes parameters measurement. These results establish basis‐independent approach to geometric phase accumulation in circularly birefringent plasmonic metasurfaces.
